lyrics:
[Intro: house piano chords, finger snaps, organ swell]

[Verse 1: warm soulful female alto]
Bad news runs, it kicks the door
Three a.m., it's on the floor
Good news likes to take its time
Stops for coffee, waits in line

[Chorus: full soulful house groove, small choir]
Good news travels slow
But it gets here, oh, it gets here
Good news travels slow
Took the long road all year
Phone lit up at noon, and now I know
Good news travels slow

[Verse 2: voice lifting, handclaps]
I kept the ringer loud for weeks
Slept with the phone against my cheek
Then here, wet hands, the midday sun
One short line: it's good, it's done

[Chorus: full soulful house groove, small choir]
Good news travels slow
But it gets here, oh, it gets here
Good news travels slow
Took the long road all year
Phone lit up at noon, and now I know
Good news travels slow

[Bridge: piano and claps only, choir answering]
(It gets here) Wait on it
(It gets here) Don't you quit
(It gets here) Every bit

[Outro: piano, choir humming, a splash, laughing]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 120 BPM, 4/4, F major. Warm, rolling and joyful soulful house.

VOICE: Female alto, warm and soulful, relaxed in the verses and lifting with a little grit in the choruses. A small mixed choir answers her in the choruses and bridge.

INSTRUMENTS: Bright house piano chords, a rolling bass guitar, a four-on-the-floor kick with handclaps and finger snaps, a Hammond organ, a tambourine, a short brass stab in the last chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:46 Chorus 1. 1:18 Verse 2. 1:48 Chorus 2. 2:20 Bridge, piano and claps. 2:44 Outro, choir humming, a splash at 3:20.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2010s soulful house: warm, clean and full, piano and voice in front, choir wide.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'One short line: it's good, it's done' at 1:42, just before the chorus returns.

STATION FIT: Sunday, noon. The happiest track of the morning, with a gospel lift for the middle of the day.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Braced, waiting, relieved, laughing.
